archive_note: GitHub archive zip of the commit above, fetched 2026-09-29; used for the licence texts and to diff against the SNESTang copy

via.note: SNESTang carries a copy of hdl-util/hdmi. Six of the eight files below are byte-identical to hdl-util/hdmi at the commit above. packet_picker.sv and audio_clock_regeneration_packet.sv carry SNESTang's change: clk_audio is sampled as a strobe in the clk_pixel domain instead of being used as a clock. SN64 takes those two files from SNESTang for that reason.

license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (hdl-util/hdmi, Copyright (c) 2019 Sameer Puri; LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE retained). The clk_audio change in packet_picker.sv and audio_clock_regeneration_packet.sv comes from SNESTang, whose repository licence is GPL-3.0 (see fpga/vendor/snestang/LICENSE). Both are compatible with SN64's GPL-3.0-or-later HDL.
not_taken: hdmi.sv (raster and island scheduler) and serializer.sv (Xilinx/Intel/Gowin primitives) are not vendored. SN64 needs an externally locked raster, so fpga/rtl/sn64_av_hdmi_tx.sv reimplements the scheduler following hdmi.sv's period arithmetic, with attribution. fpga/rtl/sn64_av_serializer.sv provides the ECP5 serializer.

files.changes: SNESTang copy (clk_audio edge-detected in clk_pixel domain). SN64 change, marked in the file: the IEC 60958 frame_counter update uses one non-blocking assignment instead of mixed blocking/non-blocking assignments (same result), because yosys-slang rejects the mix.

SNESTang copy (clk_audio edge-detected in clk_pixel domain). SN64 change, marked in the file: CYCLE_TIME_STAMP_COUNTER_IDEAL/WIDTH use $rtoi(x + 0.5)/$itor instead of int'() casts on reals (same rounding for these positive values), because Verilator 5.053 cannot constant-fold the casts. Counter width is unchanged (15 bits at 27.0198 MHz / 32 kHz).
